## **Initialization**

Load R packages, custom functions, and data needed for the analysis.

<br>

```{r load_libraries, message=FALSE}

# Load Libraries
## load CRAN libraries
library(ggplot2) # nice plots
library(dplyr) # data manipulation
library(circlize) # color functions
library(RColorBrewer) # nice color scale
library(openxlsx) #work with xlsx files
library(htmltools) # html tools for report visualization
library(reactable) # nice table visualization
library(ashr)
library(patchwork) # nice upset plots
library(ggvenn)
library(msigdbr)
library(forcats)
#library(scales) # nice scale for axis

## load Bioconductor libraries
library(edgeR) # DE analysis
library(org.Hs.eg.db) # gene annotation
library(GO.db)
library(clusterProfiler)

```

``` {r load_functions}
wd = getwd()
source(paste0(wd,"/R_custom_functions.R"))

```

``` {r load_data}
# LOAD DATA
```

## **Differential Expression Analysis:**  {.tabset .tabset-fade .tabset-pills}  

<br>

``` {r DE_analysis, results='asis'}

samples = colnames(dge$counts)

parts = strsplit(samples, "\\.")

batch = sapply(parts, `[`, 1)

replicate = sapply(parts, `[`, 2)

phenotype = sapply(parts, function(x)
    paste(x[3:(length(x)-1)], collapse = "."))

treatment = sapply(parts, function(x) tail(x, 1))

batch.rep = paste(batch, replicate, sep = ".")

group = paste(phenotype, treatment, sep = ".")

phenotype.ord = c("M0","M2","M0.M1","M2.M1")

group.ord = c("M0.Veh","M0.PM",
              "M2.Veh","M2.PM",
              "M0.M1.Veh","M0.M1.PM",
              "M2.M1.Veh","M2.M1.PM")
# Create design table for merged data
design.df = data.frame(sampleID = samples,
                       Batch = factor(batch, levels = unique(batch)),
                       Phenotype = factor(phenotype, levels= phenotype.ord),
                       Treatment = factor(treatment,
                                          levels = unique(treatment)),
                       Replicate = factor(replicate,
                                          levels = unique(replicate)),
                       Batch.Rep = factor(batch.rep, levels = unique(batch.rep)),
                       Group = factor(group,
                                      levels = group.ord))

# define colors of the clusters
sample.annot.color = c("#DDB667","#FD9F38","#F09A93","#B2172B",
                       "#A6CEE3","#599DC8","#A8D08D","#3A924A")
names(sample.annot.color)=group.ord


# Running DE Analysis
design = model.matrix(~0 + Group + Batch.Rep, data = design.df)

v = voom(dge, design = design)
voom(dge, design = design, plot = TRUE)


saveRDS(v,file=paste0(path, analyzed_data_folder, "v_edgeR.rds"))

# export normalized counts   
norm_counts.df = as.data.frame(v$E)

tagList(tags$h3("Normalized counts"),
        table_download(norm_counts.df,
    base_filename = "Normalized_counts"),
  reactable(norm_counts.df,
    searchable = TRUE,
    pagination = TRUE,
    showPageSizeOptions = TRUE,
    defaultPageSize = 5,
    pageSizeOptions = c(5, 10, 50, 100, 500)))

write.xlsx(norm_counts.df, 
           file = paste0(path,analyzed_data_folder,"Normalized_counts.xlsx"),
           rowNames = TRUE, 
           colNames = TRUE)


contrast.mat = makeContrasts(M0_PM_vs_M0_Veh = GroupM0.PM - GroupM0.Veh,
                             M2_PM_vs_M2_Veh = GroupM2.PM - GroupM2.Veh,
                             M0M1_PM_vs_M0M1_Veh = GroupM0.M1.PM - GroupM0.M1.Veh,
                             M2M1_PM_vs_M2M1_Veh = GroupM2.M1.PM - GroupM2.M1.Veh,
                             # Difference in PM response after M1 transition
                             Delta_M0M1_PM_vs_Veh = (GroupM0.M1.PM - GroupM0.PM) - (GroupM0.M1.Veh - GroupM0.Veh),
                             Delta_M2M1_PM_vs_Veh = (GroupM2.M1.PM - GroupM2.PM) - (GroupM2.M1.Veh - GroupM2.Veh),
                             levels = design)

fit  = lmFit(v, design = design, correlation = corfit$consensus.correlation)
fit2 = contrasts.fit(fit, contrast.mat)
fit2 = eBayes(fit2)
plotSA(fit2, main="Final model: Mean-variance trend")



# set log2Fold change and padj threshold to use for all subsequent analysis
log2FC.threshold = 1
padj.threshold = 0.05

#collect results in list
res.list = list()
for (i in colnames(contrast.mat)) {
  title=i
  
  # make idx title
  cat(paste("\n\n###", title,"\n\n", sep = " "))
  
  # DE results
  res = topTable(fit2, coef = title, number = Inf) 
  colnames(res) = c("log2FoldChange", "AveExpr", "t", "pvalue", "padj", "B")
  res$gene = rownames(res)
  res$diff.expr. = "NO"
  res$diff.expr.[res$log2FoldChange > log2FC.threshold & res$padj < padj.threshold] = "UP"
  res$diff.expr.[res$log2FoldChange < -log2FC.threshold & res$padj < padj.threshold] = "DOWN"
  
  # add GO terms
  res = get_human_GO_terms(res,"gene")
  
  #HTML output for report
  tab=tagList(tags$h3(paste("DEG", title)),
              table_download(res,
                             base_filename = paste0("DEG_", title)),
              reactable(res,
                        searchable = TRUE,
                        pagination = TRUE,
                        showPageSizeOptions = TRUE,
                        defaultPageSize = 5,
                        pageSizeOptions = c(5, 10, 50, 100, 500)))
  print(tab)
  
  cat("\n")
  res.list[[title]] = res
  
}


```

## **p-value plot:**  {.tabset .tabset-fade .tabset-pills}

Visualization of the p value distribution has to be anti-conservative in order to consider reliable the results of multiple comparisons test (see http://varianceexplained.org/statistics/interpreting-pvalue-histogram/).

``` {r pvalue_plot}

for (i in colnames(contrast.mat)) {
  # make idx title
  title = i
  cat(paste0("\n\n### ", title,"\n", sep = " "))
  
  # pvalue histogram
  plot = pval_hist(res.list[[i]], main = title)
  embed_plot(plot, width = 4, height = 2.5)
}

```

<br>

## **Volcano plot:** {.tabset .tabset-fade .tabset-pills}

<br>

``` {r volcano for figures}

# Volcano plot

for (i in colnames(contrast.mat)) {
  # make idx title
  title = i
  cat(paste0("\n\n### ", title,"\n\n", sep = " "))
  
  # Volcano plot
  plot = volcano.plot(res.list[[i]], 
                      lfc = log2FC.threshold, 
                      padj = padj.threshold,
                      main=title,
                      imp.genes = interest_genes,
                      top_n = 10) +
    plot_theme+
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 50))+
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-8, 8))
  
  embed_plot(plot, width = 6, height = 6)
  
  
ggsave(filename = paste0("Volcano", i,".tiff"),
         plot = plot,
         path = paste0(path,fig_folder),
         height = 10,
         width = 10,
         units = "cm",
         dpi = 300)
  
}
```

## **Venn diagram** {.tabset .tabset-fade .tabset-pills}

<br>

``` {r venn}

sel.res.list = res.list[c("M0_PM_vs_M0_Veh",
                         "M2_PM_vs_M2_Veh",
                         "M0M1_PM_vs_M0M1_Veh")]


up_genes = lapply(sel.res.list, function(x) {
    x$gene[x$diff.exp == "UP"]
})

down_genes = lapply(sel.res.list, function(x) {
    x$gene[x$diff.exp == "DOWN"]
})


cat("\n\n### Venn diagram of upregulated genes\n\n")

plot = ggvenn(up_genes,
  fill_color = c("#DDB667", "#F09A93", "#A6CEE3"),
  stroke_size = 0.5,
  set_name_size = 3,
  text_size = 3,
  show_percentage = FALSE) +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))

embed_plot(plot, width = 6, height = 6)

ggsave(filename = paste0("Venn of shared upregulated genes.svg"),
         plot = plot,
         path = paste0(path,fig_folder),
         height = 8,
         width = 8,
         units = "cm",
         dpi = 300)

shared_up = Reduce(intersect, up_genes)

cat(length(shared_up), "upregulated genes:",
  paste(shared_up, collapse = ", "))
       
cat("\n\n### Venn diagram of downregulated genes\n\n")

plot = ggvenn(down_genes,
  fill_color = c("#DDB667", "#F09A93", "#A6CEE3"),
  stroke_size = 0.5,
  set_name_size = 3,
  text_size = 3,
  show_percentage = FALSE) +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))

embed_plot(plot, width = 6, height = 6)

ggsave(filename = paste0("Venn of shared downregulated genes.svg"),
         plot = plot,
         path = paste0(path,fig_folder),
         height = 8,
         width = 8,
         units = "cm",
         dpi = 300)


shared_down = Reduce(intersect, down_genes)
cat(length(shared_down), "downregulated genes:",
  paste(shared_up, collapse = ", "))

```

## **Pathway analysis**

<br> 

### Over-representation analysis (ORA) on shared up or downregulated genes

``` {r prep_ORA}


# Set universe for ORA
universe = mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, 
                      keys=rownames(dge$counts), 
                      column="ENTREZID", 
                      keytype="SYMBOL", 
                      multiVals="first")
#load pathway DB
hallmark.db = msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H") %>%
    dplyr::select(gs_name, entrez_gene,gene_symbol)

GO.BP.db = msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C5",subcategory = "BP") %>%
    dplyr::select(gs_name, entrez_gene,gene_symbol)

reactome.db = msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C2",subcategory = "REACTOME") %>%
    dplyr::select(gs_name, entrez_gene,gene_symbol)




# Map entrez.id to up gene names
UP_genes_ID = mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, 
                       keys=shared_up, 
                       column="ENTREZID", 
                       keytype="SYMBOL", 
                       multiVals="first")

# Map entrez.id to down gene names
DOWN_genes_ID = mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, 
                       keys=shared_down, 
                       column="ENTREZID", 
                       keytype="SYMBOL", 
                       multiVals="first")

DEG.list=list(Upregulated = UP_genes_ID,
              Downregulated = DOWN_genes_ID)

```

#### Reactome

``` {r GO_reactome}

reactome_enrich.list=list()
for(name in names(DEG.list)){
  
  cat(paste("\n\n##### ORA on", name, "genes\n\n"))
  
  genes = DEG.list[[name]]
  
  # Perform enrichment
  enrich = enricher(gene = genes,
                             universe = universe,
                             TERM2GENE = reactome.db,
                             pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                             pAdjustMethod = "BH")
  enrich.df = as.data.frame(enrich)
  ## Store enrichment result
  reactome_enrich.list[[name]] = enrich.df
  
  # Plot top 10 terms
  if (nrow(as.data.frame(enrich.df)) == 0) {
    cat("No enriched terms for", name, "genes\n")
    next
  }
  
  enrich.df = enrich.df %>%
    arrange(p.adjust) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10) %>%
    mutate(Description = gsub("REACTOME_", "", Description),
           Description = gsub("_", " ", Description)) %>%
    mutate(Description = fct_reorder(Description, Count))
  
  
  plot = ggplot(enrich.df, aes(Count, Description, fill = p.adjust)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#EB2A2E",
                        high = "#FFEDA0") +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(title = name,
         x = "Gene count",
         y = NULL,
         fill = "Adjusted\nP-value") +
    plot_theme
  
  embed_plot(plot,width = 10,height = 6)
  
  ggsave(filename = paste0("Reactome on shared ",name," genes.svg"),
         plot = plot,
         path = paste0(path,fig_folder),
         height = 8,
         width = 15,
         units = "cm",
         dpi = 300)
}

```

## **Normalized counts of selected genes**

```{r counts}

# Normalized counts (CPM)
norm.counts = cpm(dge, normalized.lib.sizes = TRUE)

for (gene in interest_genes) {
  
  # skip genes not present
  if (!gene %in% rownames(norm.counts)) next
  
  # Extract gene expression values
  gene.values <- norm.counts[gene, ]
  
  # Build dataframe
  df <- data.frame(
    sample = names(gene.values),
    count = as.numeric(gene.values),
    group = group
  )
  
  group.ord <- c("M0.Veh", "M0.PM",
  "M2.Veh", "M2.PM",
  "M0.M1.Veh", "M0.M1.PM")
# Filter and order groups
df <- df %>%
  filter(group %in% group.ord) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = group.ord))
  
  # Mean per group
  df.summary <- df %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_count = mean(count),
    sd_count = sd(count),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = group.ord))
  
  # Plot
  plot <- ggplot(df.summary, aes(x = group, y = mean_count)) +
  
  # bars: fill by group, black border
  geom_bar(
    aes(fill = group),
    stat = "identity",
    width = 0.7,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  
  # standard deviation error bars: black
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_count - sd_count,
      ymax = mean_count + sd_count
    ),
    width = 0.2,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  
  # individual sample points: white fill, black stroke
  geom_point(
    data = df,
    aes(x = group, y = count),
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, height = 0),
    size = 1.8,
    shape = 21,
    fill = "white",
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.8
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = sample.annot.color) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0))+
  
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 15, 5.5, 5.5)
  ) +
  
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  
  labs(
    title = gene,
    x = "Group",
    y = "Normalized count (CPM)"
  )
  
  embed_plot(plot,width = 8,height = 5,dpi = 200)
  
  ggsave(filename = paste0("Normalized counts of ",gene,".svg"),
         plot = plot,
         path = paste0(path,fig_folder),
         height = 6,
         width = 10,
         units = "cm",
         dpi = 300)
}


```
